name: discuss
description: ADR-driven development, agent spec conventions, decision grilling, English-only artifacts, and diff explanations

interface.shortDescription: Design-time reasoning: RFCs, ADRs, project rules, decision grilling, and diff explanations
interface.longDescription: Skills for the design phase and for explaining the result. Grill a plan until the branching decisions are settled, log the discussion as an append-only RFC, record the outcome as an atomically-edited ADR, publish project rules where any harness will find them, keep every written artifact in English regardless of the conversation language, and turn a finished diff, branch, or PR into a teaching artifact — a self-contained HTML page or a MyST Markdown document with diagrams and a comprehension quiz.
defaultPrompt: Grill this plan before I implement it.
Record this decision as an ADR.
Explain this PR for someone new to the codebase.
